name: pf1e-random-char-generator-dev
description: DEV-ONLY. Foundry never reads this file -- it reads module.json, whose esmodules entry makes the browser load scripts/main.js over HTTP as an ES module. This exists so bare `node` can import scripts/*.js as ESM without the temp-dir staging hack the old harness needed, and it is excluded from the release zip by release.ps1. See tickets 11 (test tooling) and 02 (golden harness).
